limitations: Procedural teaching scenery with illustrative shapes, colors, scale and brightness. The generated barred tile adds emission structure; dim lanes reduce its own emission without computing dust extinction. It does not reconstruct measured NGC 1300 or calculate gas or stellar dynamics. Baked RGB luminance times alpha estimates do not establish equal brightness in camera views. Existing finite-star appearance and scene occlusion limits still apply. Functional and scoped accessibility checks do not measure frame rate or provide a complete accessibility audit.
